# o11y_alert_maintenance_window (Resource)

An O11y.one alert maintenance window.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Suppresses notifications for alerts whose scope matches, between starts_at and ends_at.
resource "o11y_alert_maintenance_window" "checkout_deploy" {
  window_key = "checkout-deploy-2030-01-15"
  name       = "Checkout deploy"
  reason     = "Checkout deploy; notifications resume at 04:00 UTC"

  scope_json = jsonencode({
    service_names = ["checkout"]
    environments  = ["production"]
  })

  starts_at = "2030-01-15T02:00:00Z"
  ends_at   = "2030-01-15T04:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ends_at` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `reason` (String)
- `scope_json` (String)
- `starts_at` (String)
- `window_key` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## JSON attributes

Write `scope_json` with `jsonencode()`. The provider decodes it as protobuf JSON and refuses an unknown field at plan time. Use snake_case field names and full enum names; the camelCase protobuf JSON names also work, but import and drift write snake_case.

### scope_json

`AlertScopeV1`. Selects the alerts the window covers. An alert is in the window when every non-empty field below matches the alert's own scope or instance dimensions, and a field matches when any of its values does. An empty object covers every alert.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `service_names` | list(string) | Services. |
| `service_namespaces` | list(string) | Service namespaces. |
| `environments` | list(string) | Deployment environments. |
| `customer_cohorts` | list(string) | Customer cohorts. |
| `agent_names` | list(string) | Agents. |
| `model_providers` | list(string) | Model providers. |
| `models` | list(string) | Models. |
| `tool_names` | list(string) | Tools. |
| `span_kinds` | list(enum) | `SLI_SPAN_KIND_V1_` plus `INTERNAL`, `SERVER`, `CLIENT`, `PRODUCER`, or `CONSUMER`. |
| `telemetry_attribute_filters` | list(object) | Refused: a window scope holds only the lists above. |

Each list holds at most 50 values of at most 256 bytes. The server drops blank values and `SLI_SPAN_KIND_V1_UNSPECIFIED`, which fails the apply with `Provider produced inconsistent result after apply`.

## Behaviour notes

- `starts_at` and `ends_at` are RFC 3339 timestamps, and `ends_at` must be later.
- Notifications for covered alerts are suppressed between `starts_at` and `ends_at`. Evaluation continues.

## Import

```shell
terraform import o11y_alert_maintenance_window.example <window id>
```
